item.tib: srid rgyal yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyud las srung ba mi 'jigs rdzong chen
item.coloph: ces mi 'gyur gsang sngags grags pa'am/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis/ zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba nas spyan drangs nas/ slar 'bri rdza zal ma'i sgang du shog ser la bshus shing*/ drung yig pa g.yung drung dar rgyas can gyis byas pa'i dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad 'jig med srung ba'i rdzong chen du tshud nas yum chen bdag nyid chen po'i 'bras bu thob par gyur cig/
